title: Instructions for VTCs
html:
We're always open for questions and suggestions, you can reach out to @Tumppi066 on on Discord for any questions.

#I want to block the use of ETS2LA in/with my VTC/Program

That's totally fair! We provide two ways for VTC owners to detect ETS2LA. One of these is via the log files, just look for any log containing ets2la and you'll be golden. We also provide a more reliable way through the plugin's virtual memory. For more information on how to read this check it's GitHub page, the first virtual memory entry listed in the readme is used to detect ETS2LA, and how much it's being used.

If you want to display a notice inside ETS2LA, contact us via Discord to provide us with a way to detect if you app is open. Anything goes, so long as it doesn't change between updates.

#I want to work with ETS2LA

We provide developer documentation you can access via the footer. If you need more info or want to talk to me then contact us on Discord or via contact@ets2la.com.
